definitions.explanation: A medical professional who specializes in diagnosing and treating conditions of the teeth and mouth.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}が{痛|いた}いので、{歯科医|しかい}を{予約|よやく}した。
examples.english: My tooth hurts, so I made an appointment with the dentist.

examples.japanese: {半年|はんとし}に{一度|いちど}は{歯科医|しかい}で{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}けたほうがいい。
examples.english: You should get a dental checkup once every six months.

notes:
{歯科医|しかい} is the formal/professional term for a dentist. In everyday conversation, {歯医者|はいしゃ} is far more commonly used.

FORMS:
{歯科|しか} (dental department) + {医|い} (doctor). The {科|か} means "department/branch of medicine," as in {内科|ないか} (internal medicine), {外科|げか} (surgery), and {眼科|がんか} (ophthalmology).

RELATED WORDS:
- {歯医者|はいしゃ}: dentist (casual, everyday)
- {歯科|しか}: dentistry; dental department
- {歯科医院|しかいいん}: dental clinic
- {歯科衛生士|しかえいせいし}: dental hygienist

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {歯科医|しかい}に{行|い}く: to go to the dentist
- {歯科医|しかい}を{予約|よやく}する: to make a dental appointment
- {歯科医|しかい}で{検診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける: to get a dental checkup

USAGE:
Use {歯科医|しかい} in formal or written contexts. In speech, {歯医者|はいしゃ}さん (with さん for politeness) is standard.
